package main

import (
	"os"
	"github.com/spf13/pflag"
)

type fset = pflag.FlagSet

func main() {
	fs := pflag.NewFlagSet("d", pflag.ExitOnError)
	one(fs)
	_ = fs.Parse(os.Args[1:])
}

func one(fs *fset) { two(fs) }

func two(fs *fset) { three(fs) }

func three(fs *fset) { four(fs) }

func four(fs *fset) {
	fs.String("toodeep", "", "registered four calls below main")
}
